restriction.android:title: Meerkat42 Hub URL
restriction.android:description: Base URL of the organization's Meerkat42 Hub (e.g. https://monitor.company.com).

restriction.android:title: Agent Enrollment Token
restriction.android:description: Tenant and room-scoped agent enrollment token (cpa_...) for zero-touch device onboarding.

restriction.android:title: Room / Client Group
restriction.android:description: Target room or client group slug for enrolled Android devices.

restriction.android:title: Lock Hub Configuration
restriction.android:description: Prevent end users from modifying the configured Hub URL or enrollment token.

restriction.android:title: Enable Enterprise Device Tracking
restriction.android:description: Allow periodic location check-ins when location permission is granted.
